title: Duplicate/lineage detection across reposts & re-curations
context: GEO reposts and cBioPortal re-curations can describe the same underlying Ewing cohort, risking double-counting. This task builds duplicate/lineage detection that populates lineage{duplicateOf,supersedes} so cohorts are not counted twice. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Deliver duplicate/lineage detection that populates lineage{duplicateOf,supersedes} across reposts/re-curations, as a PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects likely-duplicate or re-curated entries (GEO reposts, cBioPortal re-curations of the same cohort) and populates lineage{duplicateOf,supersedes} on the canonical records.
Prevents double-counting cohorts in catalog/index roll-ups; decisions are reviewable.
Code MIT-licensed; tests + CI green; no individual-level data in fixtures.
